title: TrainingPeaks TSS Import Freshness Gap
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainingpeaks:workout
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by athlete
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects athletes, devices, or exports that have stopped sending trainingpeaks tss data within the expected freshness window.
value: Stale performance data hides missed sessions and broken syncs, so a freshness alert protects the trend lines you rely on.
implementation: Review this at least daily and tune the freshness threshold to the normal cadence of the underlying app or export job.
visualization: Table of athlete values by hours since the last trainingpeaks tss event.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights when data for trainingpeaks tss has stopped arriving and probably needs a sync check.
